settings.title: System Settings & Preferences
settings.themeSectionDesc: The button on the top Header bar toggles directly between the Light Theme and Dark Theme configured here.
settings.tipDesc: The 1-touch button on the Header (next to the clock) directly switches between the Light and Dark designs you configured here.
settings.interfaceStyleDesc: The system operates on an advanced modern design framework, intuitive and optimized for administrative workflows.
settings.interfaceStyleModernDesc: Contemporary flat design. Spacious card margins, softer corner radii, and visual clarity aligned with modern SaaS enterprise standards.
settings.notifUrgent: Sound alerts for documents marked "URGENT" or "CONFIDENTIAL"
settings.secAutoLockDesc: Lock application securely when no mouse or keyboard activity is detected
settings.screenLockedDesc: Screen automatically locked to protect sensitive document records per Bao Long security policy.
settings.assistiveTouchToggle: Enable floating Home button on mobile (AssistiveTouch)
settings.assistiveTouchDesc: Display a floating Home button on mobile screens to quickly access the navigation menu.
settings.sidebarStyleDesc: Choose your preferred sidebar menu style.
settings.sidebarStyleFacebookDesc: Full expanded sidebar: User avatar, intuitive menu categories, direct dropdown sub-items.
settings.sidebarStyleDockDesc: Ultra-compact 76px icon dock with hover slide-out and flyout submenus.
settings.subtitle: Customize document alerts, secure session preferences, and AI Assistant models across the system.
settings.notificationSectionDesc: Customize chime sound alerts for incoming documents
settings.notifUrgentDesc: Play Web Audio chime alert for urgent and flash documents
settings.securitySectionDesc: Protect user sessions and confidential records
settings.aiModelSectionDesc: The system exclusively integrates Google Gemini technology for document summarization, entity extraction, and automated classification.
settings.aiModelGeminiDesc: Exclusive system AI engine: Ultra-fast processing, deep comprehension of Vietnamese administrative documents, smart summarization, and entity extraction.
settings.saveSettingsNote: Click the button on the right to permanently save preferences to your profile.
settings.saveSuccessDetail: Settings have been applied directly to the system.
settings.saveSuccessAlert: System settings have been successfully saved!
settings.resetSuccessAlert: Settings have been reset to factory defaults.
